description: Promoted v47b ROI-expanded near-rail endpoint selector: recovers the final four supplemental positive zero-IoU rows while preserving frozen and supplemental negative gates.

documentation.summary: v47b adds two tightly gated ROI-expanded line-endpoint candidate pools and two matching post-final selector rules for near-rail residual supplemental positives. It reduces supplemental positive zero-IoU 4 -> 0, raises derived supplemental positive Dice 0.8636358822 -> 0.8677956623, preserves old val/hard/harvest zero-IoU, keeps frozen negatives 0/376, and keeps supplemental negatives 4/1159 with identical FP IDs and zero v47b post-final activations on negatives.

notes: Promoted v41a: ultra-tight final-empty selector repairs only. Do not broaden to nonzero-final replacements without a separate learned/visual arbiter and full gates. v47a probe adds ROI-expanded line-endpoint pools for two near-rail residual zero-IoU rows; pool-only, not promoted. v47b adds two post-final selector rules for the ROI-expanded near-rail endpoint candidates. v47b promoted: ROI-expanded near-rail endpoint pools/selectors recovered all four remaining supplemental-positive zero-IoU rows with no negative-safety regression.

promotion.basis: Focused v44d zero4 board recovered all four residual supplemental positives. Visual zoom review showed target-rule-safe object-ball outgoing fragments. Frozen old_val, old_hard_val, harvest, rejected negatives, and flat negatives passed. Supplemental negatives remained 4/1159 with the same four false-positive IDs as v44d and zero post-final selector activations from the new v47b rules.
